### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR ADC IO harness | 1 |
| Remote controller | 1 | Display | 1 |
| ADC sensor | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- Here we take **MX-LLS-01-01** as an example

** Actual picture**:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3cd34f900a4acb6ebbb8d243d8936460)
MX-LLS-01-01

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=922384360be0cd35e32cceec354d5388)

#### 2. Device menu configuration
Remote control to enter menu>>Settings>>Alarm>>Input, configure ADC1 function: water volume, confirm and save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=839cfc609bcd4adba3898e83e28aa137)

#### 3. Platform menu configuration
3.1 Log in to the client, click the online vehicle plug-in to send the command form to copy the sent parameters, and the usHPX33MaxVoltage and usHPX33MaxHeight values ​​are modified according to the sensor parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET">
<stAlarmIn usHPX33MaxVoltage="10" usHPX33MaxHeight="200" ucADC1Func="3"/>
</VariCfgSec>
```
> Note:
usHPX33MaxVoltage Maximum voltage: 10V
usHPX33MaxHeight Maximum height: 200cm=2m (the parameter is filled in centimeters)

![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fd31e6be8b25860b1ba819f74dc5638b)
After the release is successful, restart the device to make the parameters effective.

3.2 In the platform WEB menu, click Operation Management--Vehicle Information--Edit Menu and check the Water Level Sensor Enable Function
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=42592076479bdc5b41b6ceaeda5c2721)
Note: Only check the Water Level Sensor. The map bubble box displays the unit L. At the same time, check the Water Level Sensor + Water Depth Sensor to display CM. This ADC water level detection height unit, so check the depth

#### 4. Test
4.1 Local View
Remote control logln+.DOT key to enter the test interface to check whether ADC1 has a voltage value
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8b387d73ca781a8b50969308df8d38fd)
4.2 Remote Platform View
Device registration platform can display water volume data in the electronic map bubble box


#### 5. Remote calibration
If the data displayed in the bubble box is not accurate with the actual water level data, you can use the platform to calibrate the ratio configuration.
5.1 Right-click the ID on the client to pop up the menu and select Water Level Sensor Settings to configure the ratio
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6db4ec89aebd51b626820ef2bbde25c3)
The water level scale value is filled with the value displayed in the bubble box, and the corresponding water level is filled with the actual value currently measured in the water tank.
5.2 Configure several ratio values ​​in multiple cycles, at least three for calibration. For example: fill the water tank with the configuration ratio for the first time, fill the water tank halfway for the second time, and fill the water tank 1/3 for the third time
